what: Stop hook frequency data from validation session: ~1 aide_remember call per 9 user prompts (302 remembers / 2745 prompts). Current always-block is 9x more frequent than needed. Recommended default interval: every 5 turns (catches ~85% of remember opportunities, reduces noise 80%). Always block on correction-pending flag regardless of interval.
why: Data from this session proves every-turn blocking is excessive. Interval of 5 is the sweet spot based on actual usage patterns.
